title: Form inventory
description: What the rendered UI says about ITSELF: for each screen, in each entity state, which machine anchors (data-field/data-section) and controls (data-action) it actually carries. Produced by rendering the real components in a test — never by parsing their source. The sibling of the route and storage inventories.

within.description: For each anchor, the containers it renders inside — the full ancestor chain of data-section / data-panel-head / data-control anchors, all instances merged. Optional: an inventory without it predates container recording, and group membership is then not judged rather than failed.
